info.title: Archthea Library API
info.description: Supabase Auth bearer tokens are verified by Express. Administrative operations require an active LIBRARIAN profile. All application writes pass through Express. Errors use { error: { code, message, request_id, issues? } }; successful JSON responses use { data: ... }. Collections return data.items, total, page and page_size. DELETE books archives; DELETE copies retires. Critical circulation writes require UUID Idempotency-Key values, retained for 30 days. Retries must reuse the same key and payload.

cover.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP; max 5 MB. Server verifies signatures and re-encodes to WebP.
